research_trace.finding: GhostPDL/Ghostscript is distributed under the GNU AGPLv3 and its source build is supported on macOS.
The official GhostPDL release page publishes Ghostscript 10.07.1 and its source archive.
The pinned source archive is Ghostscript 10.07.1; the build script verifies SHA-256 2fc74362f9be6fae1b0a65d38fdcfd4f0b518cc3b07c5581fb661eb4d2e15251 before compiling or staging it.
The release bundle retains the Ghostscript license and a project notice beside the executable.
The project build path uses the upstream configure/make/install flow when a developer Ghostscript runtime is unavailable.
